row.notes: MarshalZoneMonitor: builds marshal zones from the TrackSpace properties and subscribes to the messages r_part_detached and safety_car_deployment. Zone build (engine-re track RE round B 2026-11-17, static): one zone record per marshal_light_zone item (type 14, markup +0x1c8..+0x1d0, size check 0x1c1) of the main TrackSpace ([[[this+0x38]+0x28]+0x38]), in markup LIST order; record = {item ptr, +0x10 = item ID (+0x18)}. Neighbours are set by list index, cyclic: zone[i]+0x70 = zone[i-2], +0x78 = zone[i-1], +0x80 = zone[i+1], +0x88 = zone[i+2]. No sorting by Start, no ID or overlap check. No markup container -> logs and the monitor stays disabled (this+0x10a0 = 0); enabled = zones > 0 and the session-type flag table 0x1460fc950 bit 0..1.
